title: Existing education job watch with bounded DOE source evidence

dependency_checks: Resolve private source, output, account and executor bindings; unresolved required bindings block dependent work.
Verify current authorization, tested capabilities and one shared writer lease, including independent external sessions.
Read exact source revisions and completeness; unavailable or partial sources never establish no work.
Preserve prior complete state and reconcile uncertain output with its original request ID before any repeat write.
Resolve current recurrence/timezone, actual worker binding, private criteria and destination; retained historical prompt binding is insufficient.
Use doe_worker.py and its exact approved source grant; DOE filter coverage is not statewide coverage.
First complete read seeds state; partial reads preserve prior listings and unknown counts, never inferred closures.
Keep original candidate criteria private and separate from public source gate; report fit only with verified criteria and actual listing evidence.
Use bounded child cleanup and immutable snapshot/readback; unknown cleanup or missing atomic artifact blocks refetch.

success_checks: Packet names exact source coverage and source revision with actual changes or unchanged state.
Any suitability judgment cites verified current criteria and listing; no notification/application inferred from a packet.
Existing task destination and private receipt read back; statewide coverage and scheduled success are not claimed from DOE-only acceptance.
Record exact request, source revisions, output hash and native destination readback; label remaining coverage gaps.
